identity: Goldmead grows the grain, and Requisitioner Hobb books it as his own: grain, cloth and even a witness entered as cargo.

quests.title: A Harvest Worth Stealing
quests.text: Bracken Foxes have taken over the {name:orchards} {zone_area:orchards}, and the pickers will not go in while they are there. Clear eight of them by day. Crumb's ledger says he sent our grain to a Requisitioner Hobb; we will find out who that is once the orchard is ours again.
quests.lesson: Same neutral rule, new names: read the level range, not the name.

quests.title: The Granary Has Teeth
quests.text: After dark the same {name:orchards} fill with Granary Rats, and they do not stop at the fallen fruit. Kill eight of them at night. Work the edges; several rats close together answer one squeak.
quests.lesson: One area, two clocks; a night hunt waits while day work goes on.

quests.title: Tusks in the Wheat
quests.text: Ridgeback Tuskers trample the {name:wheatfields} {zone_area:wheatfields} faster than we can harvest them. Bring down eight by day. They are red-named and short-tempered, so do not let two of them corner you in the stalks.
quests.lesson: Aggressive animals in open fields: one at a time.

quests.title: Jon Has the Other Half
quests.text: Visit Jon Vale at Goldmead Outpost along the road. The fields are ours again, but Hobb's collectors work out of the bandit camp, and Jon watches it every day.
quests.lesson: Hub to hub inside the home zone.

quests.title: Iron Before Promises
quests.text: Bring me six Iron Bars and four Coal Lumps from the valley's ore. Check the rock's tool needs before you dig, and smelt the iron in a furnace. Hobb has given us enough paper promises; the granary doors need actual metal.
quests.lesson: The Bronze Pickaxe opens iron; smelting is anyone's work.

quests.title: Counted and Sealed
quests.text: Bring me four more Iron Bars and six planks of any wood. The first iron went into the granary; these bands and braces are for the grain shipment. I count and seal everything myself, before another collector mistakes it for his wages.
quests.lesson: Finite repair orders; prepare them between hunts.

quests.title: Feed the Counters
quests.text: Bring eight Raw Meat to me here in Goldmead Village. Our grain counters deserve a meal they cannot accidentally count as grain. Whatever you saved from the road will do nicely.
quests.lesson: Saved loot pays off on arrival.

quests.title: Cloth Around the Truth
quests.text: Bring me two Linen Cloth; the Roadside Bandits at the {name:bandit_camp} carry plenty of it. It will wrap the honest shipment. Keep the scraps for yourself; I only want cloth that was stolen from us in the first place.
quests.lesson: Camp loot doubles as a delivery.

quests.title: Bounty: Burrow Gnawers
quests.text: Burrow Gnawers chew through the {name:hedgerows} {zone_area:hedgerows} every night, and they always come back. Kill eight there after dark and I will pay again each time. The next bounty opens twenty minutes after you hand this one in.
quests.lesson: Repeatable bounty: optional XP and copper.

quests.title: Collectors Without a Collection
quests.text: Hobb's Roadside Bandits hold the {name:bandit_camp} {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp}, by day and night. Defeat eight of them. Their Bandit Lookouts shoot from the edge, so close in on one before the others notice.
quests.lesson: A camp with a ranged minor role.

quests.title: Vixens on the Road
quests.text: Thicket Vixens jump travellers along the {name:thickets} {dir_of:goldmead_outpost:thickets}. Hunt six of them by day. They are red-named and quick, and they do not care whose cart it was.
quests.lesson: Aggressive forest animals; a daytime job while the camp respawns.

quests.title: A Witness, Not Cargo
quests.text: Speak with Pella Thatch in the {name:bandit_camp}. Hobb's people hold her as cargo, but she has seen his ledgers. Clear a path and ask what she knows; she will find her own way home.
quests.lesson: A quest giver inside a hostile camp.

quests.title: Bounty: Roadside Bandits
quests.text: The {name:bandit_camp} {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp} never runs out of Roadside Bandits. Defeat eight more and I will pay the same again. The next bounty opens twenty minutes after you hand this one in.
quests.lesson: Repeatable bounty at the end of the watch line.

quests.title: Nobody Requisitions Pella
quests.text: Hobb keeps his Bandit Lookouts at the {name:requisition_camp} {dir_from_giver:requisition_camp}, day and night. Defeat eight of them so he has nobody left to shoot for him. I would do it myself, but they took my good boots.
quests.lesson: An archer camp: break line of sight, pull the edge.

quests.title: Hobb's Last Requisition
quests.text: {name:requisitioner_hobb} sits in the {name:requisition_camp} {dir_from_giver:requisitioner_hobb}, writing down other people's grain as his own. Defeat him. His ledger will prove the millers were robbed, and I would like to watch him lose an argument for once.
quests.lesson: Named normal leader at the camp centre.

quests.title: Highcourt Must Read This
quests.text: Take Hobb's ledger to Mariel Waybook in Highcourt. Every one of his requisitions carries a capital toll mark, and that is a fine place for a lie to end. The capital's stables can sell you a mount once you are allowed one.
